am.h2: Everything your family needs for a great stay
vd.h2: Hájsky dvor in a few seconds
faq.a1: The house has 11 beds in four bedrooms, and you rent the whole place just for yourselves. A baby cot is ready for your little one.
faq.q2: Are the hot tub and sauna included in the price?
faq.a2: Yes, both the hot tub and the sauna are included in your stay.
faq.q3: Is the cottage suitable for young children?
faq.a3: Yes. The yard is fenced, we have a kids' corner and a baby cot, and there are day trips nearby you can do with a pushchair too.
faq.q5: Is there parking at the house?
faq.a5: Yes, there's free parking right by the house.
faq.q7: How do I book my stay?
faq.a7: Through Booking.com, Megaubytovanie or Airbnb, whichever portal you use. If you have any questions, feel free to write to us directly.
ft.tag: An 1857 house in the heart of the Slovak Karst. All yours.
